hooks.text: 木制躯壳破碎后仍以火花形态留在本局，寻找并夺取带新能力的宿主重返战斗
hooks.excerpt: When your vessel breaks, you stay in the run as a Spark . Guide your team through the dark and search for another host with a new set of abilities. Force your way back in before you fade out completely.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 全队躯壳破坏会丢失战利品，物理恶作剧甚至能把队友火花从宿主中踢出去
hooks.excerpt: If everyone breaks, your loot is lost. Trolling can become your friend’s demise. Dropkick enemies or “accidentally” launch your ally’s Spark out of their vessel.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 把撤离战利品投入前哨重建，解锁互动家具、属性、幸存者与更深层探索能力
hooks.excerpt: Everything you haul back rebuilds your Outpost. Unlock interactive furniture, stat upgrades, rescued survivors, and stranger ways to survive the next descent. The stronger the outpost becomes, the deeper you can afford to go.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
